what: Committed receipts that claim `committed` at an object id this repository does not have. Each entry says which receipt, which id, what kind of thing it is, and why that is legitimate. receipt_provenance_audit.py fails on any such receipt that is not listed here, and on any entry here whose receipt now names a real commit.
why_this_file_exists: The tree channel records no kind of tree, so a receipt cannot say for itself whether its `committed` came from git or from an in-memory dict a caller filled. Until the format states the kind (see FINDING_tree_channel_states_no_kind_2026_09_06.md), the corpus states it here, once, checked - instead of leaving a reader to infer it from a directory name.
not_an_excuse: A declaration does not make a receipt true. It records that a human decided this particular unbacked claim is a fixture rather than an error. Adding an entry to silence the audit, without that being the case, is the failure mode this file makes visible rather than prevents.
